chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abi al-Sabbah, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot the adhan until he had prayed. He said: He does not repeat.

key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before the salat (prayer)
key_terms.لَا يُعِيدُ: he does not repeat the act of worship

ai.seo_question: Does someone need to repeat the salat (prayer) if he forgot the adhan before praying?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgot the adhan and then completed the salat (prayer). The ruling states that such a person does not need to repeat the prayer, indicating that forgetting the adhan does not invalidate it.
